reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles, and $29.99 for one month is more than Toplux or Goli, which last longer. The lab report and the named lab are nice, but I would not add another bottle at that price.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. I have too many half-finished supplements already.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $20 a box, or a bigger box that lasts longer for the same money.
